lead.headline: McLaurin and Monangai still have not practised; Irving opens with 31.5 against you
lead.deck: Nothing about your own players is newer than Thursday. Friday's reports, this afternoon, decide the flex, Jefferson and the tight-end slot.
lead.body: Start with the bad news about your own players. Terry McLaurin missed Wednesday's and Thursday's practices and, by the Washington Post's Tashan Reed, was not even at warmups on Thursday; he has not practised since the hamstring on 2 Oct. The projection still wants him in your flex by 2.3, and the practice reports, which are newer than the projection, say he may not play. Kyle Monangai has not practised either: ESPN's Jeremy Fowler reports turf toe and a status uncertain for one to two weeks, and no Bears coach has spoken since. He was on your bench anyway. Then the scoreboard. Los Gigantes de Teca's Bucky Irving ran 21 times for 165 yards and scored twice in Tampa Bay's 24–16 win at Dallas last night: 31.5 before any of your players has kicked off, and ESPN has you at 44%. Their Ja'Marr Chase was limited on Thursday and is expected to be cleared if he practises today. The week's other news is thin. Justin Jefferson and Isaiah Likely were limited on Wednesday and Thursday and nothing has been reported since; Jordan Addison and Alvin Kamara returned to practice on Thursday. Washington's other receiver, Stefon Diggs, did side work, and Jayden Daniels is back at quarterback. No leaguemate made a move that touches you: Bok-aneers claimed Trevor Lawrence overnight and dropped Tyler Shough. Nothing needs doing this morning. This afternoon: put McLaurin in the flex only if he practised; add Juwan Johnson, who is still free, only if Likely is ruled out or does not practise.
